h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Satna

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Satna

items.pText: Cement plants ring Satna, in the Vindhya region of Madhya Pradesh, and several of these companies fund schools, anganwadis and village facilities under their CSR budgets. A playground is a common CSR project because the benefit is easy to see. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for such projects at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,000 km away.

We also supply schools, colonies and gardens in Satna city. For a CSR project, the CSR team usually needs a clear proposal before it can approve spending. Send us the site size, photos and the number and age of the children. We will return suggested equipment, a layout drawing with the safe play area marked and a quote that can go straight into your proposal file.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Putting together a CSR playground proposal in Satna

c: A strong proposal covers the site, the children and the upkeep. Give the location and size of the ground, with photos, and the number of children who will use it. Attach our layout drawing and quote, along with the warranty terms. State who will look after the equipment once it is handed over, such as the school or the village panchayat.

facts.value: About 1,000 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you prepare documents for a CSR approval?
items.a: Yes. We share a layout drawing, an itemised quote and our warranty terms for each site. Your CSR team can attach these to the proposal before placing the order.

items.q: Can one CSR order cover several village schools?
items.a: Yes. Send us details and photos for each school. We prepare a layout for every site and one combined quote, and installation can be planned school by school.

items.q: Who maintains the equipment after installation?
items.a: Usually the school or local body that receives it. We explain the maintenance steps at handover, and our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 helps with spare parts.
